mapper.insert: insert into book(book_title, author, isbn, category, stock_quantity, storage_location) values(#{bookTitle}, #{author}, #{isbn}, #{category}, #{stockQuantity}, #{storageLocation})
mapper.update: update book set book_title = #{bookTitle}, author = #{author}, isbn = #{isbn}, category = #{category}, stock_quantity = #{stockQuantity}, storage_location = #{storageLocation} where id = #{id}
